# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Data Minimisation

Limits what goes into the diagnostic data: no additional log files and no memory dumps to Microsoft.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | All Devices |
| Source | ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.5.34 and A.8.11, GDPR art. 5(1)(c) data minimisation — settings from CIS v4 Windows 11 L1 |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Data_Minimisation.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Data_Minimisation.json) |

> The baseline deliberately sets telemetry to Optional because Endpoint Analytics and Windows Update reporting rely on it. That is a defensible choice, but it is at odds with data minimisation under the GDPR. These two settings take the sharp edge off without breaking the reporting: the level stays, but additional diagnostic log files and memory dumps — which may contain user data — are not sent. That is the answer to the question a DPO or auditor asks here.
